source:
Kyr {
  Module = "Module" ident string "{" Declaration* "}"
  Declaration = Kind | LocalKind | LocalSpecies | Relation | Measure | Query | Entity | Initial | Goal | Action | Budget | Description | Observation | WorldRule | Pursuit | Information | Person | Topic | Place | Exit | Passage | Thing | Event | Objective | Ending | Chapter | Promise | Occasion | Milestone | Company | ItemDecl | HazardDecl
  Place = "Place" ident string "is" ident PlaceParent? PlaceGrid? PlaceShelter? PlaceDepth? PlaceAlias? "."
  PlaceShelter = "outdoors" | "indoors" | "underground" | "elsewhere"
  PlaceDepth = integer "down"
  PlaceParent = "within" ident
  PlaceGrid = "at" integer "," integer
  PlaceAlias = "seen" "as" string "until" ident
  Company = "Company" ident string "of" integer CompanyMost? "at" ident "."
  // Of as many as are chosen for it, from the first to the second (LUL-09).
  CompanyMost = "to" integer
  ItemDecl = "Item" ident string? "is" ident ItemPlace Concealed? ItemOwner? ItemEnd
  // A thing of its own, with states and changes, carried as well as lying somewhere (QTC-A23).
  ItemEnd = "." -- plain
          | "{" ThingPart* "}" -- parts
  ItemPlace = "at" ident -- at
            | kwIn ident -- in
            | "nowhere" -- nowhere
  Concealed = "hidden" "until" ident
  ItemOwner = "owned" "by" ident
  HazardDecl = "Hazard" ident string "means" string "."
  Passage = "Passage" ident string PassageKind? "between" ident "and" ident PassagePart* "."
  PassageKind = "is" ident
  PassagePart = "one" "way" -- oneway
              | "hidden" "until" ident -- hidden
              | "needing" ident ("or" ident)* NeedsEnd? -- needs
              | "taking" integer timeUnit -- taking
              | "opening" "when" Predicate string? -- opening
  // Needed only going one way: into a place, or out from it (GTR-X08).
  NeedsEnd = "going" "to" ident -- to
           | "from" ident -- from
  timeUnit = "minutes" | "minute" | "hours" | "hour" | "days" | "day"
  Thing = "Thing" ident string ThingSite ThingKind? Concealed? "{" ThingPart* "}"
  // One end of a way: a thing on the way, or a line beside it, told only to a company at that end (GTR-08).
  WayEnd = "from" ident
  // Nowhere, as a person may be: in no place until something puts it somewhere (M19-95).
  ThingSite = "at" ident -- at
            | "on" ident WayEnd? -- on
            | kwIn ident -- in
            | "nowhere" -- nowhere
  ThingKind = "is" ident
  ThingPart = StatePart | ChangePart | HurtsPart | GuardsPart | HoldsPart | TriesPart
  HoldsPart = "Holds" "."
  TriesPart = "Tries" ident ("," ident)* "."
  StatePart = "State" ident StateFlag* string "."
  StateFlag = "blocking" | "dangerous" | "closed"
  ChangePart = "Change" ident string "from" ident "to" ident ChangeNeeds? ChangeAfter? ChangeConsumes? ChangeAt? ChangeWhen? "."
  // Made only while something holds, and why not while it does not (GTR-07).
  ChangeWhen = "when" Predicate string?
  ChangeNeeds = "needing" ident ("or" ident)*
  ChangeAfter = "after" "learning" ident
  ChangeConsumes = "consuming" ident
  ChangeAt = "at" ident
  HurtsPart = "Hurts" "with" ident "when" ident "then" ident "."
  GuardsPart = "Guards" ident "."
  Event = "Event" ident Anchor? "when" Predicate string RuleTeaches? EventTail
  EventTail = "then" "{" ChangeStatement* "}" -- effects
    | "." -- plain
  Anchor = "at" term -- at
         | "near" term -- near
         | "beside" ident WayEnd? -- beside
         | "within" term -- within
  Objective = "Objective" ident "when" Predicate ObjectiveToward? string "."
  ObjectiveToward = "toward" NonemptyListOf<ident, ","> ObjectiveRoute?
  ObjectiveRoute = "by" ident
  Milestone = "Milestone" ident string MilestoneWorth
  MilestoneWorth = "worth" integer MilestoneWhen
  MilestoneWhen = "when" Predicate "."
  Ending = "Ending" ident string EndingTail
  EndingTail = EndingOver? EndingWhen
  EndingOver = "over" NonemptyListOf<ident, ",">
  Chapter = "Chapter" ident string EndingWhen
  Promise = "Promise" PromiseHead PromiseKept PromiseBroken
  PromiseHead = ident string "to" ident
  PromiseKept = "kept" PromiseClose? PromiseWhen PromiseKeptTail
  PromiseKeptTail = string? PromiseEffects?
  PromiseClose = "at" "the" "close"
  PromiseWhen = "when" Predicate
  PromiseBroken = "broken" "when" Predicate PromiseTail
  PromiseTail = string PromiseEffects? "."
  PromiseEffects = "{" ChangeStatement* "}"
  Occasion = "Occasion" OccasionHead "{" OccasionBody
  OccasionBody = OccasionMatter+ OccasionCloses? "}"
  OccasionHead = ident string OccasionWhere
  OccasionWhere = OccasionAt? "when" Predicate
  OccasionAt = "at" ident
  OccasionMatter = "Matter" ident string MatterFor
  MatterFor = "for" integer MatterUnit MatterUntil
  MatterUnit = "minutes" | "minute" | "hours" | "hour"
  MatterUntil = MatterCondition? "."
  MatterCondition = "until" Predicate
  OccasionCloses = "Closes" string "."
  EndingWhen = "when" Predicate string "."
  Exit = "Exit" ident string "from" ident "to" ident "by" ident ExitDoor? ExitKnowledge? "."
  ExitDoor = "through" ident
  ExitKnowledge = "known" "by" ident
  Person = "Person" ident string PersonWhere "{" PersonPart* "}"
  // Where someone is to begin with; nowhere, for one not yet in the story or gone from it (WPC-04, QTC-29).
  PersonWhere = "at" ident -- at
              | "nowhere" -- nowhere
  PersonArrival = "Arrives" ArrivalAt RoleWhen "."
  ArrivalAt = "at" ident
  PersonPart = PersonArrival | PersonRole | PersonKnown | PersonRace | PersonSpecies | PersonVariant | PersonSeen | PersonCreature | PersonCount | PersonCalled | PersonWants | PersonTrait | PersonCarries | PersonClass | PersonLevel | PersonUses | PersonHorizon | StatePart | ChangePart | GuardsPart | PersonPeaceable | PersonProfession | PersonBackground | OffersPart | SellsPart | BuysPart | PersonTemperament | PersonManner | PersonPronouns | PersonAgain | PersonLeavesTo | PersonWords | PersonHaunt | PersonRemarks
  PersonTemperament = "Temperament" ident "."
  PersonManner = "Manner" ident "."
  PersonPronouns = "Pronouns" ident "."
  PersonWords = ("Warns" | "Arrives" | "Comes" | "Flinches" | "Pleads" | "Objects" | "Resents" | "Joins" | "Leaves" | "Greets" | "Farewell" | "Likeness") string RoleWhen? "."
  PersonAgain = "Greets" "again" string "."
  PersonLeavesTo = "Leaves" LeavesTo RoleWhen? "."
  LeavesTo = string "to" ident
  PersonRemarks = "Remarks at" ident string "."
  PersonHaunt = ("Lair" | "Refuge" | "Fears") ident "."
  PersonProfession = "Profession" ident "."
  PersonBackground = "Background" ident "."
  OffersPart = "Offers" ident string "for" integer "coin" "."
  SellsPart = "Sells" ident "for" integer "coin" "from" integer "."
  BuysPart = "Buys" ident "for" integer "coin" "."
  PersonHorizon = "Plans" integer "steps" "."
  PersonPeaceable = "Peaceable" "."
  PersonRole = "Role" string RoleWhen? "."
  PersonKnown = "Known as" string RoleWhen "."
  RoleWhen = "when" Predicate
  PersonRace = ("Race" | "Ancestry") ident "."
  PersonSpecies = ("Species" | "Device") ident "."
  PersonVariant = ("Aspect" | "Undead" | "Variant") ident "."
  PersonSeen = "Seen" "when" Predicate "."
  PersonCreature = "Creature" NonemptyListOf<CreatureParam, ","> "."
  CreatureParam = ident (ident | integer)
  PersonCount = "Numbers" integer "."
  PersonCalled = "Called" NonemptyListOf<string, ","> "."
  PersonWants = "Wants" ident "."
  PersonTrait = "Trait" ident "."
  PersonCarries = "Carries" ident "."
  PersonClass = ("Class" | "Calling") ident "."
  PersonLevel = "Level" integer "."
  PersonUses = "Uses" ListOf<ident, ","> "."
  Topic = "Topic" ident "with" ident TopicTravelling? string TopicAnswering? "when" Predicate TopicOnce? "{" Grave? "Says" string "." Grave? TopicEffects? "}"
  TopicAnswering = "answering" ident
  TopicTravelling = "travelling"
  TopicOnce = "once" TopicOnly?
  TopicOnly = "only"
  TopicEffects = "On" "discuss" "{" ChangeStatement* "}"
  Speaker = "Speaker" ident "."
  Grave = "Grave" string "."
  Result = "Result" string TextWhen? "."
  Otherwise = "Otherwise" string TextWhen? "."
  TextWhen = "when" Predicate
  Information = "Discovery" ident string "{" InformationPart* "}" -- parts
              | "Discovery" ident string "." -- plain
  InformationPart = KnownBy | DeniedBy | InformationSource | FoundBy
  FoundBy = "Found" "by" "searching" ident FoundWith? string? "."
  FoundWith = "with" ident
  KnownBy = "Known" "by" NonemptyListOf<ident, ","> "."
  DeniedBy = "Denied" "by" NonemptyListOf<ident, ","> "."
  InformationSource = "Source" ident string "at" ident "readable" "by" NonemptyListOf<ident, ","> Speakers? Destructible? "."
  Speakers = "spoken" "by" NonemptyListOf<ident, ",">
  Destructible = "destructible"
  Pursuit = "Pursuit" ident "for" ident string? "priority" integer "when" Predicate "seeks" Predicate PursuitUsing? "."
  PursuitUsing = "using" NonemptyListOf<ident, ","> PursuitPlanning?
  // How many ways ahead they look, for someone another file declares (QTC-A31).
  PursuitPlanning = "planning" integer "steps"
  WorldRule = "Rule" ident RuleWhere? "when" Predicate RuleOnce? RuleSays? RuleTeaches? "{" ChangeStatement* "}"
  // Only its words anchored: done wherever the company is, heard only there (QTC-A18, BOF-07).
  RuleWhere = "heard" Anchor -- heard
    | Anchor -- plain
  RuleOnce = "once"
  RuleSays = "says" string RuleAgain?
  // And after that each in turn, round again: a parrot's repertoire (QTC-A35).
  RuleAgain = "again" string RuleThen*
  RuleThen = "then" string
  RuleTeaches = "teaches" ident
  Observation = "Observe" ident Anchor ObservationInstead? ObservationAbout? ObservationAspect? ObservationBy? "when" Predicate string ObservationTeaches? "."
  // Told in place of another while it holds (QTC-A25).
  ObservationInstead = "instead" "of" ident
  ObservationAbout = "of" term
  ObservationAspect = "as" ident
  ObservationBy = "noticed" "by" ident
  ObservationTeaches = "teaches" ident
  Kind = "Kind" ident "."
  LocalKind = "Kind" ident string KindBody
  KindBody = KindBase KindPart* "."
  KindBase = "is" ident -- is
           | "like" ident -- like
  KindPart = "worth" integer -- worth
           | "weighing" signed -- weighing
           | "described" string -- described
           | "granting" ident -- granting
           | "teaching" ident -- teaching
           | "worn" "as" ident -- worn
  LocalSpecies = "Species" ident string SpeciesBody
  SpeciesBody = "like" ident SpeciesPart* "."
  SpeciesPart = "tame" -- tame
              | "temperament" ident -- temperament
              | "described" string -- described
              | "living" "in" NonemptyListOf<ident, ","> -- living
  signed = "-"? digit+
  Relation = "Relation" ident "(" ListOf<RelationParameter, ","> ")" exclusive? "."
  RelationParameter = Parameter | ident
  Measure = "Measure" ident "(" ListOf<ident, ","> ")" MeasureMost? "."
  MeasureMost = "at" "most" integer
  Query = "Query" ident "(" ListOf<Parameter, ","> ")" "means" Predicate "."
  Parameter = ident ":" ident
  Entity = "Entity" ident ":" ident string MemberBinding? "."
  MemberBinding = "bound" "to" ident
  Initial = "Initially" Change "."
  Goal = "Goal" Predicate "."
  Budget = "Budget" NumberValue "."
  Description = "Description" string "."
  Action = "Action" ident ActionParameters? string "{" ActionPart* "}"
  ActionParameters = "(" ListOf<Parameter, ","> ")"
  ActionPart = Requires | Success | Failure | Cost | Time | Resolve | Description | Result | Otherwise | Speaker | Seen | Grave
    | Interruption | Watchful | Meanwhile
  Interruption = "Interrupted" "when" Predicate "."
  // What holds while its time passes, and not after (LUL-02): Meanwhile asleep(actor).
  Meanwhile = "Meanwhile" NonemptyListOf<Call, ","> "."
  Watchful = "Watchful" "."
  Seen = "Seen" string "."
  Requires = "Requires" Predicate "."
  Success = "On" "success" "{" ChangeStatement* "}"
  Failure = "On" "failure" "{" ChangeStatement* "}"
  Cost = "Cost" integer "."
  Time = "Time" integer ("minutes" | "minute") "." -- minutes
       | "Time" integer ("hours" | "hour") "." -- hours
       | "Time" "until" TimeUntil "." -- until
       | "Time" integer "." -- fixed
       // As many watches as a value comes to: a measure, or measures and numbers added (Time crossing(way) + 2.: M19-96).
       | "Time" Value "." -- measured
  // Until an hour of the clock, or of a day: "Time until hour 19.", "Time until day 2 hour 6." (WPC-10).
  TimeUntil = TimeDay? "hour" integer
  TimeDay = "day" integer
  Resolve = "Resolve" Call "."
  ChangeStatement = Change "."
  Change = Assert | Retract | Set | Increase | Lessen | Decrease | Give | Spend | Restore | Slay | Bring
  // Whole again: every hit point, no condition, risen if fallen or dead (LUL-01).
  Restore = "Restore" term
  // Dead in the story and in the body (BOF-25).
  Slay = "Slay" term
  // Come to where whoever acts stands, or another named: a fight after a failed act (M19-94).
  Bring = "Bring" term BringTo?
  BringTo = "to" term
  Assert = "Assert" Call
  Give = "Give" GiveWhat "to" term
  // How many of a kind (Give 2 lamp_oil to actor), or one thing or one of a kind.
  GiveWhat = integer? term
  Spend = "Spend" term "from" term
  Retract = "Retract" Call
  Set = "Set" Call "to" Value
  Increase = "Increase" Call "by" Value
  Decrease = "Decrease" Call "by" Value
  Lessen = "Decrease" Call "by" ToNothing
  ToNothing = Value "or to nothing"
  Predicate = Or
  Or = And kwOr Or -- binary
     | And
  And = Unary kwAnd And -- binary
      | Unary
  Unary = kwNot Unary -- not
        | "(" Predicate ")" -- group
        | Comparison
        | Call
        | kwTrue -- true
        | kwFalse -- false
  Comparison = Value comparator Value
  // Measures and numbers, added, taken away or multiplied as the world runs: "price(?x) * 2 + toll(road)", a product
  // before a sum, and parentheses that group: "(price(?x) + toll(road)) * 2". A roll in parentheses, "(2d6)", is not
  // arithmetic, and is Deem's (NumberValue).
  Value = Product ArithTail*
  ArithTail = sumOp Product
  Product = Operand ProductTail*
  ProductTail = ("*" | "/") Operand
  Operand = "(" Value ")" -- group
          | ("min" | "max") "(" ExtremeArgs ")" -- extreme
          | "count" "(" Predicate ")" -- count
          | Call
          | NumberValue
          | ident -- given
  ExtremeArgs = Value "," Value
  sumOp = "+" | "-"
  NumberValue = expression | integer
  // A query's number is given to it as a figure: speaking(actor, 3) (GOS-12).
  Call = ident "(" ListOf<argument, ","> ")"
  argument = term | digit+
  term = variable | ident
  variable = "?" ident
  comparator = ">=" | "<=" | "==" | "!=" | ">" | "<"
  exclusive = "exclusive"
  expression = "(" expressionPart* ")"
  expressionPart = expression | quoted | plain
  quoted = "\"" (escaped | ~"\"" any)* "\"" -- double
         | "'" (escaped | ~"'" any)* "'" -- single
  escaped = "\\" any
  plain = ~("(" | ")" | "\"" | "'") any
  string = "\"" (escaped | ~("\"" | "\n" | "\r") any)* "\""
  kwNot = "not" ~identPart
  kwIn = "in" ~identPart
  kwAnd = "and" ~identPart
  kwOr = "or" ~identPart
  kwTrue = "true" ~identPart
  kwFalse = "false" ~identPart
  identPart = letter | digit | "_" | "-"
  ident = letter identPart*
  integer = digit+
  comment = "//" (~"\n" any)*
  space += comment
}
